sn44.5:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye …pe…
sn44.5:1.3: ko nu kho āvuso, hetu ko paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti?
sn44.5:1.4: rūpe kho āvuso avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.5:1.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.5:1.6: vedanāya avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa …pe…
sn44.5:1.9: viññāṇe avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.5:1.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.5:1.11: rūpe ca kho āvuso vigatarāgassa vigatachandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe… neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.5:1.15: viññāṇe vigatarāgassa vigatacchandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.5:1.16: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.5:1.17: ayaṃ kho āvuso, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
